optimizedContext.value:
# HookRunner Port

## Rules
- Declare TypeScript `interface HookRunner` in `application/ports/`; single `run` method, no abstract class.
- `run(command: string, variables: HookVariables, progressCallback?)` returns `Promise<HookResult>`.
- Progress callback reports pre-exit stdout, stderr, and silent-process liveness; preserves stream identity. Multiple updates allowed; final result unchanged.
- Expand every `{{key.path}}` by dot-path lookup before execution. Preserve token for unknown paths or complex values. Substitute only string, number, boolean; add no quotes.
- Host-shell translation:
  - Windows: convert single-quoted spans, including POSIX `'\''`, to double-quoted spans; `"` inside becomes `""`; POSIX `\"` inside existing double quotes becomes `""`; preserve other double quotes and `%`; spawn `cmd.exe /d /s /c` with verbatim arguments, hidden console.
  - Other platforms: inside double-quoted span, convert `""` to `\"` when later closing quote exists; preserve empty `""` argument and single quotes; spawn POSIX shell with `-c`.
- Command remains developer-authored: never translate programs, flags, pipes; never bypass shell via `execFile`.
- `run` always resolves. `HookResult`: `exitCode()`, complete `stdout()`, complete `stderr()`, `isSuccess()` iff exit code 0. Progress cannot weaken final capture.
- `HookVariables` aliases `TemplateVariables`, not domain value object. Caller may omit `project`; `TemplateExpander` merges builtin `project.root`. Effective map must contain it. Optional `change`: `{ name: string; path: string }`, never `workspace`; absent without active change.
- Execute built-in deterministic `run:` hooks only. Never interpret `instruction:` or external hook backends; those use separate mechanisms.
- Caller semantics: non-zero `pre-*` aborts; CLI-owned operations run `post-*` before return; agent-driven `post-*` unsupported via `run:`, use `instruction:`.

## Constraints
- No `child_process`, shell detection, platform streaming, or I/O dependency at port level.
- Re-export domain `HookResult`; `HookVariables` remains `TemplateVariables` alias.
- Subprocess failures become `HookResult`, never rejection.
- Progress callbacks observational only; never alter success/failure or final captured results.
